cause_quote: The introducing diff added `const setupCode = opts.pair ?? opts.pairIfNeeded;` and `pair = setupCode ? resolveNodePairGatewayOptions(setupCode) : undefined;`, sending the fallback code through expiry validation before the node could use its saved device token.
user_saw: Restarting an already paired node with the same `--pair-if-needed` command failed with “Pairing setup code has expired” once the fallback code expired.
summary: The fix lets `--pair-if-needed` reconnect to the saved Gateway using only the saved device token after the fallback code expires, while explicit pairing and fresh enrollment still reject expired codes.
reasoning: Path history identifies #150734 as the commit that introduced `--pair-if-needed` and documented restarting with the same command. I checked the resolver and decoder at that commit and confirmed that expiry threw before the node could reach saved-token authentication, so the post-expiry restart failed from the feature’s first release.
